label: RoleModel Software
description: House style for product demos and client-facing walkthroughs. Dark dot-grid board, generous padding, restrained motion.

rationale.borderRadius: 28 rather than the stock 40 — it echoes the 28px scene border in the Academy HyperFrames spec, so an OpenScreen capture cut next to a HyperFrames scene reads as the same system.
rationale.padding: 62 over the stock 50. The backdrop is the only branded surface in a screen demo; too little padding and the brand disappears behind the app being demoed.
rationale.shadowIntensity: 0.38 lifts the capture off a dark board. The stock 0.2 reads flat on #293747.
rationale.motionBlurAmount: Dialled down from 0.2. Motion blur on a UI recording smears text during pans, which is the opposite of what a demo needs.
rationale.cursorTheme: Deliberately 'default'. Every bundled theme is a novelty cursor (Hello Kitty, Among Us, Pokemon) — none belong in client-facing work.
rationale.webcamMaskShape: A circle in the corner, which is the shape a talking head wants: a 16:9 rectangle spends its width on the room either side of the presenter. The circle's diameter is the rectangle's height, so the face stays the same size and only the empty sides are cropped. No position is set — picture-in-picture with no explicit position already sits bottom-right, inset by 2% of the frame's short axis, and leaving it unset means re-theming a project does not undo a deliberate reposition.
rationale.webcamMirrored: Mirrored matches what the presenter saw while recording, which is what makes gestures read correctly.

vertical.$comment: vertical-stack is only honoured on portrait aspect ratios; on landscape it silently falls back to picture-in-picture.

gif.$comment: For docs pages and PR descriptions. Keep these under ~15s.
